architecture: API-backed global corpus + provenance-preserving local evidence graph

canonical_taxonomy.notes: MATERIA keeps release metadata for reproducibility and does not silently treat the Catalogue of Life as complete.

natural_products.role: microbial natural products, structures, biosources, ontology and networks

evidence_model.L2: ethnobotany, ethnomycology, ethnobiology and historical-use evidence
evidence_model.L3: clinical observations, case reports and pharmacovigilance
evidence_model.prediction: computational, inferred or model-derived relationship; never silently promoted to experimental evidence

observation_contract.rule: missing is not zero; association is not causation; prediction is not experiment

data_policy.taxonomy: Preserve accepted concepts, synonyms, source datasets and taxonomic scrutiny.
data_policy.morphology: Preserve measured traits, measurement context and developmental state.
data_policy.preparation: Preserve tissue, process, solvent, ratio, duration and formulation.
data_policy.chemistry: Keep compound identity attached to the source material and preparation context.
data_policy.evidence: Never collapse distinct evidence classes into one confidence score.
data_policy.safety: Keep toxicity, adverse events, interactions and uncertainty first-class.
data_policy.authenticity: Keep labeled, morphological, voucher, genetic and chemical authentication distinct.
data_policy.licensing: Retain source-specific license and access constraints with every imported dataset.
